contract_refinements: Store<HostState> owns one BufReader<Stdin> and BufWriter<Stdout>; import borrows state synchronously; pump reacquires state around exports. No new descriptor or syscall policy required.
write_frame already flushes; recall client also explicitly flushes. Persistent BufReader prevents dropping buffered bytes between import and frame pump.

Generated recall Host trait returns Result<WitValue, RecallError> directly, no outer wasmtime Result; linker registration uses HasSelf<HostState>. Import-walk now recognizes both frames and recall major 2.
Guest encodes errors into a TaskComplete payload. For a latched malformed record, runner emits guest output and TurnComplete, then typed desync exit6 without reading stdin again.

EOF sets a separate closed latch, preventing subsequent fetch I/O while permitting clean frame-loop EOF exit0. This follows requested EOF scenario but refines ADR amendment wording that any EOF during export is a protocol error.
@2.0 guest instantiated on @2.1 runner without alias bindings; byte-identical echo under actual T2.
Byte-string encoding is necessary: plain Vec<u8> spends 1KiB node budget per byte. Realistic1024 fits; oversized1024 trims to858 with last-included cursor and rejects859.
Longest-prefix helper searches descending, not binary: arbitrary wire cursor lengths need not make candidate encoded sizes monotonic.
KLOC rules exclude tests but do not exclude guests; prototype KLOC gate fails existing host/bin and aggregate ceilings; kernel pinned baseline still passes unchanged.
